subtests.name: Removing the focused element inside an iframe fires focusreset only at the iframe's document
Removing an iframe which contains the focused element fires focusreset at the parent document
Removing a focused iframe (with its viewport focused) fires focusreset at the parent document
Focusing an element in the parent after removing the focused iframe cancels focusreset
Focusing an element in the parent after a removal in the iframe cancels focusreset
Focusing another element in the iframe after a removal in the iframe cancels focusreset
Focusing an element in an iframe after a removal in the parent cancels focusreset
Removing the focused element in the parent doesn't fire focusreset at unrelated iframes
